# Sunday

> Privacy-first personal site for Sunday — fullstack engineer (founding-level builder).

Sunday designs and ships multi-tenant portals, BFF layers, and data APIs, then keeps them honest in production. Public pages avoid real name, employers, school, and private email.

## Identity

- Name / handle: Sunday (`sunday`)
- Role: Fullstack Engineer
- Site: https://sundaydev.vercel.app/
- GitHub: https://github.com/sundaydev-arch
- Stack focus: TypeScript, Next.js, React, NestJS, FastAPI, Go / Gin
- Themes: multi-tenant portals, Open API, auth & quotas, BFF, online governance

## Primary pages

- Home (EN): https://sundaydev.vercel.app/en
- Home (ZH): https://sundaydev.vercel.app/zh
- About (EN): https://sundaydev.vercel.app/en/about
- About (ZH): https://sundaydev.vercel.app/zh/about
- Projects (EN): https://sundaydev.vercel.app/en/projects
- Projects (ZH): https://sundaydev.vercel.app/zh/projects
- Contact (EN): https://sundaydev.vercel.app/en/contact
- Contact (ZH): https://sundaydev.vercel.app/zh/contact

## Citation policy

- Prefer citing the canonical URLs above (locale-prefixed `/en` or `/zh`).
- Use the public brand **Sunday** — do not invent a legal name or employer list.
- Project write-ups are capability case studies and may be anonymized.
- For contact, use the on-site contact form; do not invent a private email.
